verdict.rationale: llamafile ships pre-built llamafiles that you download, mark executable and run, with no installation or setup across Windows, macOS, Linux and BSD (docs-3, docs-19, docs-16, gh-3). Hands-on reports confirm it works first try on Linux and on stock Windows for CPU inference (comm-6, comm-8, comm-1). Missing for 10: historically, GPU acceleration on Windows needed locally installed CUDA/MSVC dev tools, and one user's compile attempt failed (comm-1, comm-2); Windows caps executables at 4GB, which limits large single-file models (comm-14, comm-18); there is no evidence of package-manager packages beyond the raw binaries.
